title: NFL Football
description:
Baltimore Ravens at Buffalo Bills
The Buffalo Bills host the Baltimore Ravens in NFL regular-season play at Highmark Stadium. At 5-1, Buffalo welcomes a Baltimore side that dropped to 4-3 after a 35-13 home loss to Cincinnati. Buffalo aims for a three-game win streak.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos
The Broncos (5-2) host the Chiefs (5-1) in NFL Week 8 at Empower Field at Mile High. Denver arrives off three straight wins after beating Arizona, while Kansas City remains first in the AFC West, despite a 20-3 defeat against Seattle last week.
